facts.fact: 清晨 7:00 的电话：父亲心脏病离世——那一刻世界慢动作。
facts.anchor: Your father has passed away. It was a heart attack.

facts.fact: 花圈、棺花全部独自操办——她把 Sean 挡在外面（重演 ch20 的 solo 模式）。
facts.anchor: I had to tell him what felt like a million times, that I needed to do it alone.

facts.fact: Hanford 小餐馆的 comfort food 勾出父亲：烤奶酪三明治是他偷懒晚餐的 go-to。
facts.anchor: He loved making grilled cheese when I was growing up.

facts.fact: Stony's Pizza 独食传统：他躲 Eloise 的唯一出口——她提过一次同行，被拒，从此不再问。
facts.anchor: go to the pizza buffet place on Main Street

facts.fact: 自责如浪：他最后的日子，她陪的是别人家——也许本可以察觉端倪。
facts.anchor: I spent his last days with someone else’s family.

facts.fact: 悼词草稿的记忆：五岁流感吐他一身 OSU 卫衣，他不恼不吼——只求你好受。
facts.anchor: He’d let you puke all over him, just so you were comfortable.

facts.fact: 悼词写到「怕忘记他的声音」就写不下去——临场放弃致悼词。
facts.anchor: I opted out of the eulogy at the last minute.

facts.fact: 墓园人满为患：Sean 提前到场确认布置；连九十岁的老篮球教练都来了。
facts.anchor: Friends that he grew up with—even an old basketball coach.

facts.fact: Eloise 停车场现身（妆花了）说要来悼念——她一句 Good for you 拒收，车开走时后视镜里那句话：Just where she belongs.
facts.anchor: I heard about Wesley. I needed to come
